title: Where the $423B/year invasive species bill goes (%)

source.name: Invasive Alien Species Assessment
source.publisher: IPBES (Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services)

notes: The IPBES assessment found the large majority of invasive-species costs come from damages and losses already incurred, with only a small share spent on prevention and management -- a rounded characterization of that finding.
